rules.RawHexLiteral: SME6340: hexadecimal literal in functional code (ratcheted)
rules.PointerDispatch: SME6341: primitive compared with, offset from or switched over an address-valued code constant (ratcheted)
rules.OpaqueWordArray: SME6342: integral array literal holding hexadecimal words (ratcheted)
rules.CatalogHexLiteral: hexadecimal literal owned by a named definition catalog (inventoried)
rules.JustifiedHexLiteral: functional hexadecimal literal with a reviewed same-line allowance (inventoried)
rules.RawWidthOperation: SME6345: shift by a byte/word/bank width or byte/word/bank mask in functional code (ratcheted, #223)
rules.OwnedWidthOperation: width operation inside a catalog or [SnesEncodingOwner] type that documents it (inventoried)
rules.JustifiedWidthOperation: functional width operation with a reviewed same-line allowance (inventoried)

classes.NumericQuantity: 1. real numeric quantity: use decimal and ordinary or unit types
classes.DomainIdentity: 2. mutually exclusive identity: an enum once the domain is proven
classes.ComposableBits: 3. composable bits: [Flags] only where the cartridge composes them
classes.StructuredInstruction: 4. structured instruction or definition: a typed record, timeline or state transition
classes.CartridgeAddress: 5. cartridge address or encoded boundary value: a typed catalog or decoder
classes.Unknown: 6. unknown semantics: kept at the boundary under an explicit unresolved name

classification: Each occurrence's class is proposed by the scanner from its syntax (array element, address range, enum or [Flags] member, switch arm, bitwise operand, pointer-named context, equality or arithmetic); the subsystem migration confirms or corrects it.
